styles.name: 动漫与漫画
styles.description: 手绘赛璐璐、浓墨漫画、厚涂动漫、剧场手绘与二维贴纸实景合成

options.label: 90 年代手绘赛璐璐
options.value: 1990s hand-painted cel animation, variable-weight ink contours, flat opaque color and a single tier of crisp shadow shapes, with softly painted backgrounds and clean figure-ground separation

options.label: 浓墨漫画
options.value: bold manga pen-and-ink drawing, heavy silhouette contours, tapered interior lines, solid brush-black shadows and sparse screentone midtones over paper-white highlights

options.label: 厚涂动漫
options.value: painterly anime illustration with simplified expressive facial geometry, opaque overlapping brush planes and softly modeled form, crisp focal contours and broad, broken brushwork at the edges

options.label: 手绘剧场动画
options.value: hand-drawn theatrical animation still, flowing pencil-cleaned contours and stepped cel shadows over layered gouache scenery, deep multiplane separation and luminous painted highlights

options.label: 二维贴纸与实拍感环境
options.value: a flat, cel-colored sticker with a clean pale cutout border composited into a photographic-looking environment, preserving its simple drawn contours and grounding it with aligned perspective and a small contact shadow

options.label: 茶褐与暖米白
options.value: tea-brown shadows and warm ivory in the background, with restrained burnt-orange accents

options.label: 冷蓝灰与琥珀
options.value: slate-blue scenery with a few warm amber accents in the environment

options.label: 墨黑与纸白
options.value: strict monochrome with dense ink black, gray screen tones and paper white

options.label: 黑白加朱红
options.value: black and white with a single muted vermilion accent in the surrounding design

options.label: 雾蓝与浅杏
options.value: muted powder-blue surroundings with pale apricot highlights in the environment

options.label: 松绿与陶土
options.value: deep pine-green environmental shadows with restrained terracotta accents

options.label: 城市灰与明黄
options.value: near-neutral urban grays in the photographic layer with a bright yellow environmental accent

options.label: 深青与淡珊瑚
options.value: deep teal surroundings with a small pale-coral environmental accent

styles.name: 绘画与手工插画
styles.description: 水粉、水彩、油画、木刻、刻线版画、刺绣与半写实数字绘画

options.label: 水粉绘本
options.value: opaque gouache picture-book illustration, lightly irregular edges, overlapping matte pigment shapes and soft planar shadows, with crisp dry-brush marks at the focal detail

options.label: 湿画法水彩
options.value: wet-on-wet watercolor on absorbent paper, transparent washes with pooled pigment and feathered edges, reserved paper whites and a few selectively sharpened focal marks

options.label: 刮刀厚涂油画
options.value: palette-knife oil painting with thick impasto ridges, broad interlocking paint planes and strongly modeled shadows, showing broken color and angled knife edges around the focal forms

options.label: 套色木刻版画
options.value: hand-printed color woodcut, carved white channels and uneven ink transfer, solid ink blocks with visible paper grain and graphic positive-negative shapes

options.label: 刻线版画感
options.value: scratchboard-like ink illustration with dense tapered light incisions cut into solid black masses, hatch direction following the contours and hatch spacing modeling volume. Use a toothy matte paper surface, visible scattered grain and clean reserved highlights

options.label: 织物刺绣
options.value: hand-embroidered illustration on woven fabric, directional satin stitching that follows each contour, tiny overlapping threads, raised tactile edges and subdued thread shadows

options.label: 半写实数字绘画
options.value: semi-realistic digital painting with observed proportions and believable volume, layered matte brushwork, selective edge control and broad soft shadows, keeping fine detail concentrated on the main focal forms

options.label: 苔绿与陶土
options.value: soft moss-green background shapes with muted terracotta accents

options.label: 暗紫与杏粉
options.value: dusty plum shapes in the background with pale apricot accents

options.label: 雾蓝与暖灰
options.value: diluted fog blue and warm-gray washes on near-white paper

options.label: 灰绿与淡赭
options.value: transparent gray-green washes and soft ochre accents on warm white paper

options.label: 熟褐与金赭
options.value: deep umber in the setting and golden-ochre background highlights

options.label: 普鲁士蓝与赭红
options.value: dark Prussian-blue background planes with small red-ochre accents

options.label: 靛蓝与棉纸白
options.value: indigo shadows and exposed cotton-white paper in the surrounding scene

options.label: 氧化红与深松绿
options.value: oxide-red and deep pine-green ink blocks around the focal forms

options.label: 灰橄榄绿与朱红
options.value: a muted olive-green background with sparse vermilion-red accents for a restrained near-complementary red-green contrast, keeping the drawing's ink blacks and warm paper whites legible

options.label: 深青绿与墨蓝
options.value: an analogous blue-green and blue palette in the surroundings, with deep teal as the dominant field and muted ink-blue secondary shapes, keeping warm ivory paper highlights and black hatchwork intact

options.label: 燕麦底布与锈红
options.value: natural oat-colored fabric with rust-red stitching in the background

options.label: 午夜蓝底布与浅金
options.value: midnight-blue fabric with muted gold stitch accents in the background

options.label: 青灰环境与暖橙
options.value: cool blue-gray surroundings with restrained amber-orange environmental highlights

options.label: 梅紫灰与柔和橄榄绿
options.value: muted plum-gray surroundings with subdued olive-green accents

styles.name: 海报与平面设计
styles.description: 几何色块、孔版套印、剪纸拼贴与一位色抖动

options.label: 现代主义几何色块
options.value: modernist graphic poster built from clean circles, diagonals and interlocking opaque color fields, with hard figure edges, deliberate negative space and flat unshaded interior planes

options.label: Risograph 孔版套印
options.value: risograph poster with two translucent spot inks around the focal design, a visible third tone where those inks overlap, fine stencil grain, slight registration offsets and knockout areas of exposed paper

options.label: 手撕纸拼贴
options.value: layered torn-paper collage with irregular fiber edges, overlapping matte stock and shallow contact shadows, shaping the focal forms from clean cutouts against larger torn background pieces

options.label: 一位色抖动图形
options.value: one-bit graphic with explicit pixel-scale contours, exactly two visible tones, ordered dithering in midtones and clean silhouette separation at the focal shapes

options.label: 低饱和矿物色块
options.value: slate blue, soft terracotta and ivory color blocks in the surrounding design

options.label: 橄榄绿与奶油白
options.value: dark olive and light cream as the dominant poster fields

options.label: 藏蓝与朱红套印
options.value: navy and vermilion spot inks in the surrounding design, with off-white paper exposed

options.label: 孔雀蓝与珊瑚橙套印
options.value: teal and coral spot inks in the surrounding design, with cream paper exposed

options.label: 牛皮纸与珊瑚橙
options.value: warm kraft-paper layers with pale coral paper accents

options.label: 靛蓝卡纸与灰白
options.value: indigo card stock with gray-white layered background shapes

options.label: 纯黑与纸白
options.value: pure black as the dark tone and paper white as the light tone

options.label: 深靛蓝与米白
options.value: dark indigo as the dark tone and warm ivory as the light tone

styles.name: 3D 与定格
styles.description: 柔和动画 CGI、复古低模、黏土定格、做旧潮玩与液态铬雕塑

options.label: 柔和动画 CGI
options.value: stylized animated-feature CGI with rounded modeled forms and subtle surface roughness, broad soft-edged key light and gentle bounce, keeping the contours and focal surface details crisp

options.label: 复古低模与 CRT
options.value: early-console low-poly rendering with explicitly faceted silhouettes, limited texture resolution, diffuse polygon lighting, visible stepped tonal bands and a fine CRT scanline texture

options.label: 手捏黏土定格
options.value: clay stop-motion on a miniature set, hand-shaped matte volumes, shallow fingerprints and slight seams, with directional set illumination and clearly grounded contact shadows

options.label: 做旧潮玩渲染
options.value: weathered designer-toy render with rounded molded vinyl-like forms, sharp raking highlights that reveal pebbled coating grain and scuffed edges, and worn stencil graphics wrapping around the curved surfaces. Keep the backdrop graphic and flat and avoid legible lettering

options.label: 液态铬金属雕塑
options.value: liquid chrome sculpture render with flowing mirror-metal curves, narrow bright specular bands and broad reflected shapes, using distinct highlights to keep each sculpted edge legible

options.label: 石蓝与淡桃
options.value: slate-blue environmental bounce with restrained peach-colored accents

options.label: 薄荷绿与琥珀
options.value: mint-green surroundings with soft amber bounce in the environment

options.label: 靛紫与青柠
options.value: a limited palette of indigo-violet background facets and sparse lime accents

options.label: 砂黄与深青
options.value: a limited palette of sand and deep teal on background facets

options.label: 奶油黄与砖红
options.value: cream-ochre set pieces with small brick-red accents

options.label: 薄荷绿与暖灰
options.value: mint-green and warm-gray miniature set pieces

options.label: 炭黑与荧光莓红
options.value: a neutral charcoal-gray base with fluorescent raspberry-red as the single accent hue, concentrated in a flat background panel and a few small stencil marks

options.label: 深紫与柠檬黄
options.value: complementary violet and yellow, with deep violet dominating the backdrop and sharp citrine-yellow confined to small stencil accents and restrained reflected highlights

options.label: 冰青反射与炭灰
options.value: icy cyan reflected set accents against a charcoal environment

options.label: 琥珀反射与深蓝灰
options.value: small amber reflections against a dark blue-gray environment

styles.name: 人像摄影与棚拍
styles.description: 自然抓拍、定向光棚拍、直闪街头、35mm 彩色负片与银盐黑白

options.label: 自然抓拍
options.value: candid portrait photography with available light, natural skin texture and a gentle highlight roll-off, preserving spontaneous expression and contextual background detail without a polished studio finish

options.label: 定向光棚拍人像
options.value: low-key portrait photography using a narrow directional key and controlled fill, deep but readable shadows and restrained specular highlights, preserving natural skin texture

options.label: 直闪街头人像
options.value: direct on-camera flash portrait with crisp near-plane detail, quick falloff into the setting and a hard flash shadow, preserving the candid texture of skin and fabric

options.label: 35mm 彩色负片人像
options.value: 35mm color-negative portrait with exposure-dependent fine grain, open shadows and a soft highlight shoulder, keeping skin texture natural and hue shifts restrained

options.label: 银盐黑白人像
options.value: silver gelatin black-and-white photography with fine silver grain, controlled highlight separation and long continuous grayscale transitions across skin and fabric

options.label: 中性日常色
options.value: neutral white balance and understated environmental colors, with natural skin tones

options.label: 暖中性色
options.value: gently warmed midtones and neutral skin highlights, with restrained background color

options.label: 咖啡棕影调
options.value: warm dark-brown surrounding tones with neutral skin highlights

options.label: 冷石板灰影调
options.value: cool slate-gray surrounding tones with natural skin highlights

options.label: 中性直闪色调
options.value: neutral flash-lit skin with a slightly cool, subdued environment

options.label: 冷直闪与暖环境
options.value: neutral flash-lit skin against a restrained warm-amber environment

options.label: 暖肤色与青灰阴影
options.value: subtly warm skin, muted blue-green environmental shadows and natural fabric colors

options.label: 中性肤色与浅暖高光
options.value: neutral skin and slightly warm environmental highlights with muted background colors

options.label: 饱满灰阶
options.value: full monochrome tonal range, from paper-white highlights to deep but separated blacks

options.label: 低反差哑面黑白
options.value: soft matte grayscale with lifted blacks and restrained highlights
